scope: closed evidence CPU-only attribution; no new execution, benchmark or projected speed claim
limitations: First-request enqueue stall has no kernel-family/event split; lazy driver compilation/paging/first-use effects remain hypotheses. Zero fills at position1 does not mean zero host expert reads.
Cache counters are cumulative bytes scheduled for cache fills, not hit-rate, committed residency, or additive foreground wait.
prefill_ms includes last prompt token producing first generated token; first_generated_token_ms is that one step, not TTFT.
wait_ms is host wait duration, not a separable transfer/kernel latency; unprofiled device counters zero and family null are unavailable measurements.
Append/fresh is intentional reuse qualification in one fixed order, not a cold benchmark improvement. First and final A have different owner/cache history; no regression/speedup inference.
Twofold prefill and three-percent decode calculations are sensitivity examples only, not predictions. No class profiling, additional run, cache reset, model reload, or device action performed.
